newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation April load factor down.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation April load factor down.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation said Tuesday its passenger load factor fell to 42.5 percent in April from 45.0 percent in April 1996.
Revenue passenger miles were 23.4 million, compared to 25.4 million a year ago, and available seat miles were 55.0 million, down from 56.4 million a year ago.
For the four months ended in April, passenger load factor was 41.8 percent, down from 43.8 percent a year ago, the airline said.
Revenue passenger miles were 87.7 million, compared to 91.3 million a year ago and available seat miles were 210.0 million, compared to 208.3 million a year ago.
Great Lakes shares fell 1/4 to 1-5/8 Tuesday.
